required_correction_http_checks: Approved native time exposes a read-only correction review
Correction review requires sign-in
Read-only time access cannot prepare a correction
Read-only time access can follow original and replacement history
Timesheet screen distinguishes read-only history from correction authority
Time managers receive correction navigation in the original workspace
Correction review reads source and current permanent identities without creating or changing records
Manual correction requires the reviewed original revision
A different correction review cannot replace this original
Correction cannot silently accept changed approved evidence after review
Correction cannot silently accept a changed assignment after review
Retained parent-ledger accounting history blocks ordinary correction before any posting
Actual billing source lines protect time even without extracted flags
Actual ap source lines protect time even without extracted flags
Unrelated bundle number equal to entry number does not falsely prevent correction
Original entry membership finds a linked invoice bundle despite absent consumption flags
Ready downstream amounts cannot silently retain superseded original time
Consumed source bundle remains protected even when document lines are absent
Original correction history survives placement retirement without rewriting identity
Retained history does not grant correction of a retired assignment
Cyclic correction history is refused without rewriting rows
Ambiguous predecessors cannot be presented as a valid correction chain
Reviewed correction returns both original and replacement weeks after a date change
Replacement does not inherit approval, rate or dimension authority
Reviewed cross-week correction updates both totals once
Replacement history links back to its original and records the correction reason
Multiple reviewed corrections retain the full ordered original and replacement chain
Shared directories do not expose another workspace time correction or history
A replacement pointer cannot disclose foreign-workspace time or silently truncate its history

initial_run.note: Ten jobs passed, including 654 concurrency, 953 native session and 707 contract HTTP checks. Core smoke exposed new navigation bypassing resolved platform-admin context. Fixed navigation and correction/history endpoints to use the existing context-aware permission path; added permanent person/placement numbers to review. Final acceptance is tied to the exact successful candidate.
